## Summary

Close the native **reverse** handoff ingress admission/lifetime gap in #3613 without changing direct/local defaults, grants, protocol, phone fields or outgoing synchronization.

- Carry the original inbound request, principal, TLS server and canonical saved trust into actual queued/postauthorization decisions, rather than trusting an outbound link or replacement principal.
- Own actual incoming domain work through queue waits, saves and committed-history notifications; stop/replacement drains this work. Preserve truthful admitted commits and distinguish canceled RPC replay from deadline-unretained results.
- Preserve genuine old-host failures, isolated guard mutants and all originals. Canonical pairing/PEM capture and historical testcase metadata corrections are independently approved for this exact source/proof.

## Changes and boundaries

Only four production files change: `annex-server.ts`, `handoff-host.ts`, `handoff-coordinator.ts`, `handoff-service.ts`. Four associated test files and desktop-only contract/evidence accompany them.

The native route captures original inbound authority before the body await and uses receiver-side `reverseRequestLive(req)`. A synchronous reverse-only guard reaches actual offer/cancelled-offer/cancellation/snapshot queue admission, including existing/older/no-op decisions. It also checks both positive authorization and typed-refusal branches after their awaits. Full positive authorization remains; retained history/cancellation keep existing exceptions.

Actual incoming promise ownership starts before domain awaits and ends only after actual settlement. Before admission, retirement refuses this message's mutation. After admission, a save may finish and publish matching memory/history notices: no post-save fake 403/400, rollback or replacement-authority inference. Expiry/prune remain separately admitted local maintenance, not a global zero-write guarantee. Existing outer control wire authorization still suppresses unauthorized/dead responses.

C1 is one production line relative940: `JSON.stringify([annexPeers.trustOf(peer), peer.kind])`. It includes canonical pairing ID and saved PEM, faithfully permits an originally undefined legacy ID, and excludes benign route/alias/lastSeen changes. Shared trust policy, grants and control refresh are untouched.

C2 matches exact `name`/`classname` attributes and derives all **185** historical names/classes/statuses from the same sealed raw XML: 110 final + 31 queue-mutant + 44 postauthorization-mutant. Original hashes, counts, classes, statuses and defective packet remain intact. This is archival derivation, not new execution or successor-source coverage.

## Fixture preservation and acceptance limits

All106 fixture JSON files /1,547,788 bytes, including103 canonical mobile files /1,529,625 bytes, retain baseline Git identities. The original packet checks59 protected inputs and87 unchanged lower/synchronization proof files; combined review verifies preserved trees and protected source bridges.

Accepted lower source/proof `a4074c7f5e76714bbe346ecee1acfc434307de0e` / `be01f8bd511dba2a625462021732c119ce6b170e`, review `74d2ed4f64c1e9d539339e5a75b7c3c31171e8b3`, and synchronization source/review `9a5247cadf41756bc1c085a87c59493b34d5e99f` / `6f15b83d35a86b25dd24cfac4289de3bc9440909` remain reused by identity, not rerun. The earlier81,937 bytes remain envelope fidelity only;614,417-byte lower proof adds no new native content/application credit.

Native fixtures use real TLS/router/control/authorizer/stores but synthetic metadata, fixture Dispatcher and absent runtime; neither desktop client runs. Some deadline/mixed-lifetime controls use fake timeout timers. Saved-PEM substitution is a synthetic inconsistent record, not a valid re-pairing or observed incident. Genuine cancellation can retain an admitted answer; deadline destroys the response and yields `not_retained`/unavailable replay. Same-key replay cannot execute again; existing cache/slot limits are unchanged.

**Not claimed or changed:** real grant/preparation/approved MCP producer, worker/content-through-coordinator/apply/wake/provider, human gates, real two-host/full-handoff/full-duplex acceptance, protected Details/Naming/Q5, accepted unrelated54-FAIL disposition, phone/wire fields, settings/shared stores, local E2E/full suite, installation, release or manual CI dispatch.

- [ ] Real native grant/preparation/content/application/wake/two-host product acceptance remains deferred to its existing owners and actual human/host gates, not substituted with these fixtures or hosted E2E.

No local E2E was run. Hosted E2E is separate ordinary workflow coverage, not full handoff acceptance.
